brand.feature_interview: Interview practice in the format employers use

change.noOtherWay: Without the current number, you need another sign-in method on this account to confirm it is you. If you have none, contact support from the Help page.

planSheet.sub: Pro raises your daily limits. A pass is paid once and never renews.

cancel.help: A pass is paid once and never renews, so there is nothing to cancel. You keep Pro until {date}.
cancel.helpNoDate: A pass is paid once and never renews, so there is nothing to cancel. You keep Pro until it ends.

page.facts: Salary, years of experience, degrees and similar questions are filled only from answers you saved. AI never writes them.

settings.sub: Your inbox keeps every alert, reminder and notice.

how.step2: Your friend creates a new %BRAND% account with the link, confirms it and finishes setting up.
how.step3: You each get {credits, plural, one {# practice interview credit} other {# practice interview credits}}.

workspace.intro: Open a job to see what fits and what's missing. With ranking by your profile on, jobs are ordered by how well they line up with it; with it off, by date posted.

q3.a: It says how well your resume lines up with the job post: title and level, skills, industry, location and pay, and how your career has moved. It is not your chance of getting hired.

pricingPage.sub: Every price and usage limit is on this page.

linkedin.title: Bring in a resume you already have
linkedin.body: If you keep a resume on another job site or in a document, export it as a PDF and upload that file here.

resume.subtitle: Start from a blank page or upload the one you have. Then tailor a copy for each job you want.

empty.sub: Create your first one — from scratch or from an upload — and every line gets checked.

issue.contact_links: Add a portfolio or personal page link to give recruiters somewhere to dig deeper.
